rows.config: Gemma-4-12B, GGUF, NVFP4, f16 KV, no drafter, thinking off
rows.command:
llama-server -m ~/.cache/llama.cpp/hf/FreedomAISVR/Gemma-4-12B-it-NVFP4-GGUF/gemma-4-12b-it-nvfp4.gguf \
  --alias gemma-4-12b-nvfp4 --no-mmproj --parallel 1 \
  -ngl 999 --fit off -fa on -c 262144 \
  --cache-type-k f16 --cache-type-v f16 \
  --jinja --port 8081
rows.note: pi id `gemma-4-12b-nvfp4`. A community NVFP4 repack of the model, the run's headline NVFP4 row: the weights leave room for the trained 262,144 window at f16 KV. Every cell is pending until the first run closes; `-c 262144` is the planning value.
